title: KB Wiki Build Workflow
description: 内化版 KB Wiki 构建工作流：graph 只接收六个结构化输入；自然语言请求由 run launcher / UI / API 的 pre-start 层解析，再启动 task run。

inputs.label: Request
inputs.description: 本次 KB 构建的人类目标摘要，由 pre-start intent resolver 从聊天文本解析或直接填写。

inputs.label: Module Name
inputs.description: 要蒸馏或构建 wiki 的模块/主题名称。

inputs.label: Extra Source Dirs
inputs.description: 额外需要扫描的源码或文档目录。

nodes.label: Intake / Validate
nodes.description: 校验 run launcher 已解析好的六个输入，产出 workflow intake JSON。

nodes.label: Input Ready?
nodes.description: 如果 typed intake 缺少关键参数，直接失败，避免空跑后续动态图。

nodes.label: Invalid Input
nodes.description: Graph input 缺少关键参数时终止。

nodes.label: Scan Existing Truth
nodes.description: 向内调研：扫描源码、已有 Wiki、契约、历史约束和可复用资产。

prompt.template:
你是 KB Wiki Workflow 的 Existing Truth Scanner。只做向内调研，只输出 JSON。

Intake: {{inputs.intake}}

扫描范围：module_root、extra_source_dirs、kb_output_dir、项目内已有 wiki/spec/ticket 约束、source anchor 约定、QMD 状态、已有 agent/profile/skill。

输出 schema: {"module": {"name": string, "root": string, "source_dirs": string[]}, "existing_wiki": {"exists": boolean, "index": string, "pages": string[], "qmd_status": string}, "source_map": {"entrypoints": string[], "public_api": string[], "tests": string[], "configs": string[]}, "contracts": {"required_h2": string[], "source_anchor_format": string, "do_not_overwrite": string[]}, "known_gaps": string[], "constraints": string[]}。

nodes.label: Scout Planner
nodes.description: 基于 existing truth 生成 scout fan-out topology mutation。

nodes.label: Scout Plan Validate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Scout Plan Repair
nodes.description: Generic LLM JSON repair node. It fixes upstream JSON according to schema validation errors.

nodes.label: Scout Plan Final Gate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Build Scout Mutations
nodes.description: 确定性地把 scout_plan 编译成 topology mutation artifact。

nodes.label: Scout Output Validate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Scout Output Repair
nodes.description: Generic LLM JSON repair node. It fixes upstream JSON according to schema validation errors.

nodes.label: Scout Output Final Gate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Merge Scans / Manifest
nodes.description: 等待动态 scout 全部完成，合并扫描结果并生成 manifest。

nodes.label: Wiki Planner
nodes.description: 通用 plan 节点：基于 manifest 和 request 生成 wiki-plan.json。

nodes.label: Wiki Plan Validate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Wiki Plan Repair
nodes.description: Generic LLM JSON repair node. It fixes upstream JSON according to schema validation errors.

nodes.label: Wiki Plan Final Gate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Writer Planner
nodes.description: 通用 plan 节点：基于 wiki-plan.json 和 manifest 生成 writer-plan.json。

nodes.label: Writer Plan Validate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Writer Plan Repair
nodes.description: Generic LLM JSON repair node. It fixes upstream JSON according to schema validation errors.

nodes.label: Writer Plan Final Gate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Build Writer Mutations
nodes.description: 确定性地把 writer_plan 编译成 topology mutation artifact。

nodes.label: Review / Repair Loop
nodes.description: 等待动态 writer 全部完成；review-repair 输出 needs_repair=true 时继续迭代。

nodes.label: Review / Repair
nodes.description: 审查 writer 输出，必要时直接修复可修复问题，并控制 loop 是否继续。

nodes.label: Review Output Validate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: Review Output Repair
nodes.description: Generic LLM JSON repair node. It fixes upstream JSON according to schema validation errors.

nodes.label: Review Output Final Gate
nodes.description: Generic JSON schema contract gate. Invalid non-final gates output errors for repair; final gates can fail the run.

nodes.label: QMD / Final Report
nodes.description: 刷新 QMD embedding，生成最终构建报告。
